description: Reviewed commitment-to-evidence index. References only; no private content or copied model output.

entries.failureSignal: a governance or release claim cannot be traced to reviewed evidence
entries.rollbackOrDisable: withhold the next gate and keep the claim at its verified stage

entries.failureSignal: admission bypasses durable quota, epoch, or contract checks
entries.rollbackOrDisable: keep the capability in observe and fail closed on contract mismatch

entries.failureSignal: external observation influences action while its capability release state is not active
entries.rollbackOrDisable: fail closed on capability or contract mismatch

entries.failureSignal: a proposal mutates the live checkout or capability state without an external human action
entries.rollbackOrDisable: quarantine the proposal and keep verified status system-derived

entries.failureSignal: nuclear and continuity lineage diverges or a sidecar is silently replaced
entries.rollbackOrDisable: fail closed and preserve the current lineage evidence

entries.failureSignal: forget, fork, or restore behavior loses lineage or overclaims erasure
entries.rollbackOrDisable: fail closed on lineage mismatch and preserve non-erasure receipts

entries.failureSignal: content is visible without a truthful receipt-backed delivery state
entries.rollbackOrDisable: abort or finalize the reservation honestly and preserve partial receipts

entries.failureSignal: the production OS boundary is inferred from a design document or same-user execution
entries.rollbackOrDisable: do not authorize broker execution until the implementation gate is accepted

entries.failureSignal: emotion, expression, or dependency is used to manipulate or punish
entries.rollbackOrDisable: block proposed influence and require a reviewed gate before implementation
